(function(){
let sourceUrl = GET('server');

// server自动对齐：搜索结果书籍可能属于其他家族域名(base32ID站与数字ID站不互通)，以详情页og:url实际域名为准
let mAlign = String(result).match(/og:url" content="https?:\/\/([^\/"]+)\//);
if (mAlign && ('https://' + mAlign[1]) !== sourceUrl) {
  java.log('server自动对齐: ' + sourceUrl + ' -> ' + mAlign[1]);
  SET('server', 'https://' + mAlign[1]);
  sourceUrl = 'https://' + mAlign[1];
}

// GoEdge人机验证页防御(qmzw5等)：过盾后按from参数回跳重取详情页
if (/GOEDGE_WAF_CAPTCHA_ID/.test(String(result))) {
  java.toast('站点人机验证，请在弹窗中输入验证码');
  if (goedgeVerify(sourceUrl, String(result))) {
    let fromP = (String(result).match(/from=([^&"']+)/) || [])[1];
    result = String(java.ajax(sourceUrl + (fromP ? decodeURIComponent(fromP) : '/')));
  }
}
if (/<title>Verify Yourself<\/title>/.test(String(result))) throw new Error('站点人机验证未完成，请刷新重试');

// 遍历页面引用的全部 /templates/js/*.js，直到找到含AES密钥的那个
// （部分站点如 x630xsw/369shuba 的首个JS是无密钥的公共文件）
let regex = /src="(\/templates\/js\/[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,}\.js)"/g;
let m, bookId = result.match(/content=".*\/book\/(.*?)\.html"/)[1];
SET('bookId', bookId);
java.log('bookId: ' + bookId);

// 菠萝猫站点无需AES密钥（HTML目录）
if (sourceUrl.indexOf('boluomao') >= 0) { return result; }

let found = false;
while ((m = regex.exec(result)) !== null) {
  let jsUrl = sourceUrl + m[1];
  // 密钥JS请求带重试：站点会重置冷连接TLS，失败时返回的是异常文本
  let resp = '';
  for (let rt = 0; rt < 3; rt++) {
    resp = String(java.ajax(jsUrl));
    if (!/javax\.net\.ssl|Exception|reset by peer|Failed to connect/i.test(resp)) break;
    if (rt < 2) Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(400);
  }
  let secretKey = (resp.match(/AESCrypt\('(.*?)'\);/) || [])[1];
  let ivKey = (resp.match(/parse\('(.*?)'\);/) || [])[1];
  if (secretKey && ivKey) {
    cache.put(sourceUrl, JSON.stringify({ secretKey, ivKey }));
    java.log('密钥来源: ' + m[1]);
    found = true;
    break;
  }
}
if (!found) java.log('警告: 未能提取AES密钥');

return result;
})();
</js>

  if (/GOEDGE_WAF_CAPTCHA_ID/.test(resp)) {
    java.toast('站点人机验证，请在弹窗中输入验证码');
    if (!goedgeVerify(serverUrl, resp)) throw new Error('人机验证未通过或已取消，请刷新目录重试');
    continue;
  }
  if (/403\s*Forbidden|人人书云/i.test(resp)) {
    if (rt >= 3) { is403 = true; break; }
    // 自愈: GET首页刷新会话cookie, 梯度等待(5s -> 30s)后重发
    java.ajax(serverUrl);
    Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(rt == 0 ? 5000 : 30000);
    continue;
  }
  try {
    var pj = JSON.parse(resp);
    list = pj.data;
    // 业务Error(code!=0且无数据)多为AES密钥已轮换：重建密钥并重算本页加密参数后重发
    if ((!list || list.length === 0) && pj.code !== 0 && rt < 3) {
      if (rebuildTocKey(serverUrl, id)) {
        url = serverUrl + "/index.php?action=loadChapterPage," + JSON.stringify({
          "body": `data=${dataEncrypt(JSON.stringify({ id, page }), serverUrl)}`,
          "method": "POST",
          "headers": hd
        });
      }
    }
  } catch (e) { list = null; }
  if (list && list.length >= 0) break;
  if (rt < 3) Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(500);
}
if (is403) { cdnBlocked = true; break; }
if (!list) throw new Error('目录接口失败(page=' + page + ')，请刷新目录重试');
list.forEach(x=>{
if (x.chapterurl && !/^https?:/i.test(String(x.chapterurl))) x.chapterurl = serverUrl + x.chapterurl;
res.push(JSON.stringify(x))
});
// 页间节流500ms：连续快速POST易触发站点CDN频率限制
if (page < pages) Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(500);
}

// ===== CDN限流降级：/chapter/{id}.html页面自带作品目录(正序约100章)，保底可读 =====
if (cdnBlocked) {
  java.log('CDN限流(403)，降级加载chapter页面目录');
  let dch = '';
  for (let rt = 0; rt < 3; rt++) {
    dch = String(java.ajax(serverUrl + '/chapter/' + id + '.html' + ',' + JSON.stringify({headers: JSON.stringify({'user-agent': MOBILE_UA})})));
    if (!/javax\.net\.ssl|Exception|reset by peer|Failed to connect/i.test(dch)) break;
    if (rt < 2) Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(500);
  }
  let dd = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(dch);
  let das = dd.select('.chapList ul li a');
  if (das.size() == 0) throw new Error('站点CDN限流中且降级目录不可用，请等待几分钟后再刷新目录');
  // 最新章节区与作品目录区存在重叠且前区为倒序：按URL数字去重+升序保证正确顺序
  let seen = {}, arr = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < das.size(); i++) {
    let a = das.get(i);
    let href = a.attr('href');
    if (!href || href.indexOf('.html') < 0) continue;
    let mN = href.match(/-(\d+)\.html/);
    let num = mN ? parseInt(mN[1]) : (1000000 + i);
    if (seen[num]) continue;
    seen[num] = true;
    arr.push(JSON.stringify({ chaptername: a.text().trim(), chapterurl: (/^https?:/i.test(href) ? href : serverUrl + href), chapterorder: num }));
  }
  arr.sort((a, b) => JSON.parse(a).chapterorder - JSON.parse(b).chapterorder);
  arr.forEach(x=>{ res.push(x); });
  java.log('降级目录章节数: ' + res.length);
}

res.sort((a, b) => JSON.parse(a).chapterorder - JSON.parse(b).chapterorder);
res;
}
